tasks.short: Prepare written case opinions or decisions

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual case record, submissions and applicable source material for the written opinion
inputs: Actual party-produced submissions and case evidence
Existing case-management system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Verified case version, source documents and open evidence issues

steps.what: Determine the actual conclusions, reasons and limits of the opinion or decision within the case mandate
inputs: Actual verified case and relevant sources
outputs: Decision-maker's conclusions, reasons and selected source references

steps.what: Fill exact case identifiers, party names and decision-maker-selected references into the native opinion template
inputs: Specific references selected and captured in s2
outputs: Draft opinion structure with source-linked administrative fields

steps.what: Write the actual opinion or decision, including the substantive reasoning and disposition
inputs: Actual human conclusions and reasons from s2
outputs: Complete human-authored written opinion or decision

steps.what: Check the complete final written opinion or decision for reasoning, source support, parties, disposition and actual mandate
outputs: Exact checked final opinion version

steps.what: Save the exact checked written opinion or decision
inputs: Exact complete final version checked in s5
outputs: Saved written opinion with actual draft or final status

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} template fields from verified {OTHER} case records and references selected by the decision-maker. All conclusions and substantive writing remain human, with the complete final opinion checked before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Administrative document fields and reference formatting can repeat already verified case facts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked fields and reference styles can reproduce exact selected information.
tasks.still_hard: Legal reasoning and a justified disposition require accountable human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate the evidence and explain the actual reasons for the conclusion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates can reuse verified case fields and format selected references without producing legal reasoning or decisions.

assumptions: Conditional written-opinion episode with actual manual administrative-field assembly; not measured baseline or assumption that mediators issue binding decisions.

Parties and case owners produce original documents. Decision-maker collection, source verification and selected-reference capture are counted in s1-s2, with all substantive writing in s4; no free pre-authored reasoning.

Native template features first; existing linked fields and reference formatting earn zero new saving. Missing identifiers and references remain manual; no generated case citations or legal conclusions.

Actual authority and document status are checked in s5. Saving is negligible and fully retained; issue, signature, service or external send requires its own final-version authorization and separate action with labour added if actually in scope.
Shared legal reasoning with 20238 or 20240 is counted once in a team/role roll-up. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross field-assembly saving 15 less upkeep 2 gives net 13.
unknowns: Actual opinion type, authority and current template coverage
research_questions: Which administrative fields are still re-entered after current case/document features?

already_counted.description: Case verification, substantive conclusions, actual opinion writing and complete final review

incremental.description: Maintain exact case-field mappings and reference styles

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete written opinion checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual administrative-field saving 15 minus upkeep 2; all legal reasoning and substantive writing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply relevant legal and policy sources to case conclusions

steps.what: Find actual potentially relevant laws, regulations, policies and precedents using the real case question
inputs: Existing authorized legal research library, defined as OTHER
outputs: Candidate real source documents with provenance and version

steps.what: Read the actual sources and determine relevance, authority, current status and interpretive limits
outputs: Human assessment of relevant source propositions and limits

steps.what: Examine actual case evidence and disputed facts relevant to the source propositions
inputs: Actual party evidence and case record
outputs: Human assessment of facts, disputes and evidential limits

steps.what: Apply relevant laws, regulations, policies or precedents to the actual evidence to reach supported conclusions
outputs: Human legal/policy reasoning and conclusions

steps.what: Capture and check the actual working conclusions and exact supporting source references
outputs: Complete checked working-conclusion note

steps.what: Save the exact checked working-conclusion note
outputs: Saved actual working conclusions

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} legal-library search and exact source links to support source discovery. The decision-maker reads, evaluates and applies every relevant source and checks the actual {DOCS} working note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source discovery can consume time before the actual legal analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters can reuse explicit case-related queries and expose real source documents.
tasks.still_hard: Authority, applicability and the relation of facts to rules require human reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate actual sources and explain why they support a conclusion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native legal-library search can reduce repeated discovery while source authority and application to evidence remain human judgements.

assumptions: Conditional legal-analysis episode with an actual existing working note, not a measured baseline or an added report after every thought.

Actual source publishers and parties produce sources; decision-maker reading, status/applicability checking, evidence assessment and actual conclusion capture are fully counted. No free legal analysis or generated citations.
Native features first; existing saved queries earn no new saving. Missing sources remain manual and no source is excluded solely by a model.
Save is negligible and fully retained. No binding decision issuance or external send is hidden. Same reasoning/note work included in 12999 must be counted once.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross discovery saving 4.5 less upkeep 1 gives net 3.5.
unknowns: Actual research library and repeated-query effort
research_questions: Which source-discovery operations remain manual after current native research features?

already_counted.description: Retained source discovery and full source authority/relevance checking and actual working-note capture/checking

incremental.description: Maintain explicit source queries and source links

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete working note checked in s5; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional discovery saving 4.5 minus upkeep 1; legal application and all actual writing retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct hearings to obtain case information and evidence

steps.what: Find and verify the actual hearing file, participant details and already-submitted evidence
inputs: Existing case-management system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Checked hearing file and identified evidence gaps

steps.what: Determine the actual hearing questions and process within the assigned mandate
inputs: Checked file and actual disputed issues
outputs: Human hearing plan and questions

steps.what: Conduct the actual hearing, ask questions, hear parties and examine information or evidence relevant to the claims
inputs: Human hearing questions and actual mandate
outputs: Actual heard evidence, explanations and unresolved issues

steps.what: Capture the actual required hearing record and check its complete account, evidence references and unresolved disagreements
outputs: Complete checked hearing record

steps.what: Save the exact checked hearing record
inputs: Exact complete record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual hearing record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} case views and fixed {DOCS} hearing-record fields. The decision-maker plans and conducts the hearing and captures and checks the actual full record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case navigation and repeating identifiers can add preparation and recording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and forms can reduce navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: Obtaining evidence and understanding disputed accounts require live procedural judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, ask appropriate questions and preserve disagreements accurately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case views and record fields can support hearing administration while questioning and substantive evidence capture remain human.

assumptions: Conditional hearing with an actual required focal-role hearing record; not a measured baseline or a new transcript duty.
Parties produce submissions; decision-maker file checking and actual hearing record capture are counted in s1 and s4. No free transcript, cleaned evidence or automatically inferred witness account.
Native features first; existing equivalent views and forms earn zero saving. s4 reduces fixed identifiers only, retaining substantive account writing and full final checking.

Save is negligible and fully retained. Hearing notices, process orders, record circulation or decisions, if actually in scope, need separate complete final-version checks and sends/commits; none is silently automated.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 2.25 plus 1.4 equals 3.65, less upkeep 1 gives net 2.65.
unknowns: Actual record ownership and current case-linked hearing forms
research_questions: Which file-navigation and fixed-field entry remain manual after native hearing tools?

already_counted.description: Retained file checks, actual hearing-plan reasoning and substantive post-hearing record capture/checking

incremental.description: Maintain native case view and fixed hearing fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete hearing record checked in s4 after the actual hearing; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional file lookup and fixed-field saving 3.65 less upkeep 1; hearing and substantive record work retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine extent of liability from actual evidence and applicable sources

steps.what: Read and verify actual evidence, claimed amounts and relevant laws or precedents for the liability question
inputs: Actual case evidence and party claims
Actual relevant legal sources in the authorized research library, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human-verified evidence, amount components and relevant source propositions

steps.what: Determine the actual extent of liability using the evidence and applicable sources, authoring any chosen allocation and amount components
inputs: Actual verified facts, disputes and sources from s1
outputs: Human liability determination, reasons and explicitly selected arithmetic inputs and calculation rule

steps.what: Calculate exact totals from the decision-maker's selected amount components and explicitly chosen allocation rule
inputs: Human-selected amount components and exact arithmetic rule captured in s2
outputs: Traceable arithmetic worksheet with missing inputs held, without any inferred liability decision

steps.what: Write the actual liability working determination and check the complete reasons, evidence, selected rule and calculated amounts
outputs: Complete checked liability working record

steps.what: Save the exact checked liability working record
inputs: Exact complete working record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual liability working determination

tasks.design: Use native {SPREADSHEET} formulas for arithmetic selected and specified by the human decision-maker. The decision-maker determines liability, writes the actual reasoning and checks the complete {DOCS} working record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Where arithmetic is performed manually, summing chosen components can consume effort after the substantive decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can reproduce explicit arithmetic with traceable inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence weight, legal applicability and the extent of liability require accountable judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what responsibility the evidence supports and explain the reasons.

ambition.what: Support exact arithmetic within the existing liability determination.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet formulas can calculate explicit human-selected amount components without deciding legal liability or selecting an allocation rule.

assumptions: Conditional liability case that actually includes manual amount arithmetic and an existing working record, not a measured baseline for every liability determination.

Parties produce original claims and evidence; decision-maker source verification, liability reasoning, amount selection and explicit rule capture are fully counted in s1-s2. No free selected damages schedule or model-decided responsibility.

Native formulas first; current calculators or worksheets are baseline and earn zero new saving. Missing amounts, disputed components and legal rule applicability remain human decisions, with no inferred percentages or automated conclusions.
All actual substantive writing and full final checks remain in s4. Save is negligible and fully retained, with no award issuance, party send or payment hidden.
Same legal reasoning and record work shared with 12999 or 20238 is counted once. All 100 illustrative focal points: gross arithmetic saving 20 less upkeep 2 gives net 18.
unknowns: Actual amount-calculation practice and current native arithmetic tools
research_questions: Which explicit calculations remain manual after existing case worksheets, and how much actual effort do they consume?

already_counted.description: Actual evidence and legal-source evaluation, entire liability determination and actual record writing and full check

incremental.description: Validate and maintain explicit arithmetic formulas

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete liability working record checked in s4; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional demonstrated manual arithmetic saving 20 minus upkeep 2; all substantive liability reasoning retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
